description: Claim staking rewards from a specific stake position. If the position is already unlocked, this also withdraws the staked principal. First use printr_get_staking_positions to find positions with claimable rewards or that are unlocked. Uses the treasury wallet to sign and submit the transaction. Returns the transaction hash/signature on success.

creation_tx.description: Transaction ID that created this stake position

position.description: CAIP-10 address of the stake position to claim rewards from

name: printr_claim_staking_rewards
